product: Resale app for second-hand designer and premium high-street clothing that prices, lists and ships items in about ninety seconds

banned_claims: side hustle that pays your bills
banned_topics: earnings promises or repeatable income framing
negative framing of a named retailer, brand or influencer
prices for items not currently live in the app
body-shaming or weight-loss framing of a wardrobe clear-out
licensed or uncleared music on the Instagram cut
reused decks from other resale clients
rules.tone: Honest, plain-spoken UK-native confession — small and specific about your own spending, never polished sales talk or judgement of other companies.

guidance.hook_style: Slide one is a real photograph (messy floordrobe, overstuffed rail, bin bag by the door, a receipt) with a confessional text overlay rather than a claim or a text card.
angles: The audit — total up a year of clothes spending slide by slide, then show the first three things you listed on Vestra Closet
One piece, its whole life — a coat bought new, worn twice, listed, and what it sold for (highest-converting angle)
The rail swap — same rail before and after a clear-out, photographed in daylight
I stopped buying new for 60 days — diary format: what you listed, what you bought second-hand, what you missed
Listing speed — screen-record one item going from photo to live listing, timed
notes: #ad must sit in the first line of the caption, not buried and not after the hashtag block
Write Vestra Closet in full on first mention in every caption and on every slide where the name appears as text; only shorten to Vestra after that first mention
Keep overlay text under twelve words per slide
Final slide should carry the app name and a plain call to action; the app appearing only on the last slide fails placement
UK-native phrasing performs better — trainers, jumper, quid; American slang underperforms
You may describe one personal sale and what it sold for, framed as a single sale rather than repeatable income
Second-hand, resale, circular and 'one less new thing bought' are approved sustainability wording
No haul content and no get-ready-with-me — both tested and flopped for this brand
TikTok photo carousels and Instagram carousels only — no Reels, Shorts or Pinterest
Eligibility: 4,000+ followers, three posts in the last 30 days over 10,000 organic views, account skewing female 60%+ or fashion/thrift-coded
Posts must stay live at least 30 days; deleting early voids payment and bought traffic forfeits the whole balance
Optional but advised: post a draft in the #vestra-closet Discord channel for a placement and naming check
Campaign window closes 30 June or when budget is exhausted, with 48 hours' notice in Discord
Rates are quoted in GBP: £1.30 per 1,000 TikTok views and £0.95 per 1,000 Instagram views
